name: Ground: game sky
when: Behind a full-screen graphic when no shot goes with the scene but a real sky of the game reads better than a flat gradient. Its sky is a frame of a gameplay clip with open sky (a sunset is best), named on the graphic: "ground_frame": "@frame gameplay/<clip id> <seconds>". Give every ground-E scene of a video the same frame.
anchor: None of its own: it starts and ends with the full-screen graphic on top.

vars.sky: the baked sky: a 1920x1080 .jpg in the project's assets/ (build_video.mjs bakes assets/grounds/<graphic id>-sky.jpg with the recipe from the graphic's ground_frame)
vars.out: seconds: the ground's length, the same as the full-screen graphic on top (make_scene sets the scene's length from it)

recipe_vars.{frame}: a 1920x1080 still of a gameplay clip with open sky, the graphic's ground_frame ("@frame gameplay/<clip id> <seconds>"), cut by build_video.mjs; the recipe keeps its top-left 76 % (the sky) and grades it
recipe_vars.{sky}: the output .jpg in the project's assets/

placement: Mount it under a full-screen graphic (layer fullscreen) with the same --start, and set out to the graphic's length. Its host goes below the graphic's host in z-index.
source: algrow-gta-pipeline/lab/ground/index.html, preset "sky", plate from tools/prep_grounds.sh + tools/bake_plate.sh (validated as ground-E: out/ground_E.mp4)
changed: The lab drew the ground inside each full-screen scene (one CSS preset for all of them); here it is its own scene, mounted under the graphic. The lab also tinted the cards' shadows on this ground (rgba(60, 14, 22, a) instead of black): shadows belong to the graphic on top, so they are not part of this template. In the lab the article scene faded in over 0.27 s together with its ground; here the ground is simply cut in and the graphic on top does its own entry. The push-in (104 % to 112 %, linear over the length) is a GSAP scale on the sky image instead of the lab's animated background-size: same framing.
